label: MiMo Token Plan Lite
limits: Fixed Monthly Quota: 4.1 billion Credits. 'Using mimo-v2.6-flash as the baseline, it can execute approximately 200 rounds of medium-to-complex tasks.' v2.6-pro: 300 credits/input token (cache miss), 2.5 cached, 600 output. 'When the monthly total quota of your plan is used up, the system will suspend the service.' Off-peak (00:00–08:00 Beijing) 0.8x.
notes: ¥39/mo. Annual: $63.36/yr (¥411.84). Monthly quota only, with no 5-hour or weekly window in the docs. 12% first-purchase discount. No refunds. MiMo-V2.5-Pro and MiMo-V2.5 were retired on 2026-10-21; every tier now has 'mimo-v2.6-pro, mimo-v2.6-flash, as well as ASR and TTS models'. Xiaomi documents integrations for several third-party tools, but the subscription terms prohibit 'API calls for request behaviors in obvious non-coding scenarios', such as automated scripts and custom application backends. The page's CNY annual prices are ¥408, ¥1,044, ¥3,468 and ¥6,948, slightly below the converted figures in these notes.
